Peter takes good friend and Super Bowl champ Chris Jones, from the Kansas City Chiefs, fishing; Chris is hoping for sailfish and tuna with only a four-hour window to fish; he is coming from training camp and only has a limited time to fish.

title: Livin' the Dream With Captain Jimmy Nelson
description:
S09 E07 — Yellowfin Tuna in Paradise
Livin' the Dream follows Captain Jimmy Nelson and his wife Luiza as they travel and fish in exotic locales.

title: Facing Waves
description:
S13 E04 — Kayaking the Waitukubuli Sea Trail - Part 2
Ken Whiting continues his exploration of the Caribbean's first and only sea kayaking trail - the Waitukubuli Sea Trail in Dominica.
